  public struct Empty

    field text: String

    field right: Long

  public fun managedEcho(text: String): String
    @Extern(lib = "m23_scoop_leaf", name = "m23_leaf_echo", abi = "scoop")
  public fun leafEcho(text: String): String

  public fun aggregate(value: Aggregate): Aggregate
